name: Julian
source:
“S-Soul.. Tak-e-Take... Sou-Soul..”

A shadowy spirit freed by Rosalyn, Julian can’t speak clearly, but he understands everything. Though he acts like a mischievous cat, he’s still a soul-hungry entity bound to a dark past—and to her.
